packageRules.description: m68k is the correctness-critical CPU/FPU core, exact-pinned on purpose (see Cargo.toml) -- its own group, separate from every other Cargo bump, and never auto-merged. Each bump has a real history of needing hardware-comparison review (FINT/FINTRZ, extended-float rounding) before merge, not just a passing CI run.
GitHub Actions (version and digest bumps, including the setup-python version pin) are low-risk and already CI-gated -- group them and auto-merge once checks pass.
Docs tooling (mkdocs-material etc. in tools/docs-requirements.txt) doesn't touch runtime correctness -- group and auto-merge once checks pass.
The Dockerfile's rust:alpine base image feeds every release binary -- pin its digest for supply-chain integrity, but keep bumps manually reviewed rather than auto-merged.
